categories.main_business_segments: Huntington Bancshares operates two primary business segments: Consumer & Regional Banking and Commercial Banking. Consumer & Regional Banking provides a broad range of financial products and services to individuals and small to mid-sized businesses, including deposits, lending, payments, mortgage banking, wealth management, and insurance. Commercial Banking serves mid-market to large corporate clients with lending, treasury management, capital markets, asset finance, and specialty banking solutions. The Treasury/Other segment includes corporate functions, technology, and unallocated items.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages a digitally powered banking platform, integrating online and mobile banking, advanced ATM networks, and customer call centers. It utilizes proprietary tools such as Money Scout®, Huntington Heads Up®, and The Hub for financial management, and employs advanced risk management, cybersecurity frameworks, and data analytics. Huntington also invests in innovation through partnerships and acquisitions, such as digital payments and investment banking capabilities, and uses AI and automation to enhance operational efficiency and customer experience.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Huntington serves a diverse customer base including retail consumers, small and mid-sized businesses, large corporate clients, government entities, and institutional investors. Key end markets include consumer banking, mortgage lending, auto and dealer finance, wealth management, commercial real estate, healthcare, technology, and specialty finance sectors. The bank also targets underbanked communities and entrepreneurs through specialized programs.
categories.geographic_coverage: Huntington operates primarily in the Midwest and Great Lakes regions, with 978 full-service branches and private client offices across Ohio, Michigan, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Pennsylvania, West Virginia, Wisconsin, Minnesota, Colorado, Florida, and North Carolina. It maintains a local presence in South Carolina and Texas, and conducts select financial services nationally through specialty channels.
categories.supply_chain_position: As a regional bank holding company, Huntington operates downstream in the financial services supply chain, directly interfacing with end customers for deposit-taking, lending, payments, and advisory services. It also acts as an intermediary in capital markets and asset finance, and provides distribution finance to dealers and manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Huntington’s strategic focus is on being a leading people-first, customer-centered bank, emphasizing digital transformation, product innovation, and geographic expansion. Key R&D and innovation themes include enhancing digital banking capabilities, expanding payments and capital markets offerings, investing in cybersecurity and data privacy, and developing ESG and climate risk management programs. The company actively seeks technology partnerships and acquisitions to augment its product suite and distribution channels.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through net interest income from loans and deposits, as well as noninterest income from payments and cash management, wealth and asset management, capital markets and advisory fees, mortgage banking, insurance, and service charges. Additional revenue streams include leasing, investment banking, and transaction-based fees. Huntington also earns income from investment securities and bank-owned life insurance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Huntington competes with regional and national banks, credit unions, savings and loans, non-bank lenders, fintechs, and large technology companies entering financial services. Major competitors include regional banks like Fifth Third, KeyCorp, PNC, and national players such as JPMorgan Chase and Bank of America. Huntington holds leading deposit market share in several key MSAs (e.g., #1 in Columbus, OH), and differentiates itself through local delivery, customer service, and innovative, customer-friendly products.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2024, Huntington had $204.2 billion in total assets, $162.4 billion in deposits, and $130.0 billion in loans and leases. 2024 net income was $1.9 billion, with net interest income of $5.3 billion and noninterest income of $2.0 billion. The company has demonstrated steady organic growth in loans and deposits, supported by strategic acquisitions and investments, and maintains strong capital and liquidity positions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Huntington emphasizes a 'Fair Play' banking philosophy, offering customer-friendly products such as 24-Hour Grace®, Asterisk-Free Checking®, and Standby Cash®, designed to enhance transparency, convenience, and financial wellness. The bank differentiates itself through local market expertise, personalized service, digital innovation, and a comprehensive suite of financial solutions rivaling larger banks, while maintaining a strong community focus and commitment to ESG and inclusion.
